skillsets.title: Model access-control invariants
skillsets.defensive_objective: Document expected actor, action, resource, and tenant relationships in an authorized design review

skillsets.title: Review identity lifecycle
skillsets.defensive_objective: Assess binding, verification, recovery, linking, and revocation requirements using approved test accounts

skillsets.title: Review approval-state integrity
skillsets.defensive_objective: Check that approval records bind to immutable content and survive state changes safely

skillsets.title: Reason about concurrent state
skillsets.defensive_objective: Model ordering assumptions and prove security invariants with local state-machine or unit tests

skillsets.title: Review cloud IAM boundaries
skillsets.defensive_objective: Compare intended service authority with documented effective permissions and least-privilege requirements

skillsets.title: Threat-model integrations
skillsets.defensive_objective: Trace documented trust assumptions between services and identify where authorization responsibility changes

skillsets.title: Model build and release trust
skillsets.defensive_objective: Map trusted and untrusted inputs, artifacts, jobs, and identity boundaries in approved architecture diagrams

skillsets.title: Review artifact isolation
skillsets.defensive_objective: Assess separation of caches and artifacts by trust level, and define integrity controls

skillsets.title: Review dependency provenance
skillsets.defensive_objective: Check explicit registries, namespace ownership, lockfiles, source pinning, and package-origin policy

skillsets.title: Review machine identities
skillsets.defensive_objective: Document bot and service identity privileges, rotation, approvals, and separation of duties

skillsets.title: Review secrets containment
skillsets.defensive_objective: Assess whether secrets are limited to the minimum necessary trusted execution contexts

skillsets.title: Review input trust boundaries
skillsets.defensive_objective: Assess validation and data/code separation without collecting offensive payloads

skillsets.title: Review AI authority boundaries
skillsets.defensive_objective: Assess least privilege and independent validation at tool execution and data disclosure boundaries

skillsets.title: Review parsing and serialization
skillsets.defensive_objective: Reason about parser consistency, validation, and safe serialization contracts

skillsets.title: Review client isolation
skillsets.defensive_objective: Study process, origin, memory-safety, and permission boundaries in patched historical cases

skillsets.title: Write bounded security evidence
skillsets.defensive_objective: Separate demonstrated impact, modeled impact, remediation, and source uncertainty in review findings

skillsets.title: Review text-encoding invariants
skillsets.defensive_objective: Identify and document validation contracts at extension and parser boundaries, then verify them with safe unit tests

skillsets.title: Review memory-safety assumptions
skillsets.defensive_objective: Assess length, bounds, allocation, and lifetime assumptions in owned source code and vendor patches

skillsets.title: Verify remediation evidence
skillsets.defensive_objective: Compare vendor advisories, affected versions, fixes, and regression coverage without reproducing an exploit

skillsets.title: Review security-token design
skillsets.defensive_objective: Assess unpredictable generation, subject and operation binding, limited lifetime, single-use semantics and safe validation of security-sensitive tokens

skillsets.title: Review secure error behavior
skillsets.defensive_objective: Verify that failure responses minimize disclosure and that fallback paths preserve the original authorization context
